newsitem.title: GHANA: Few shares traded on Ghana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Few shares traded on Ghana bourse.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange notched up one of its quietest sessions of the year on Monday, with just 4,210 shares changing hands, its market report showed.
Offers outpaced demands by 949,310 shares to 154,010.
The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share index inched up 0.22 points to close at 358.33.
Consumer products company Unilever rose five cedis to 765 cedis, followed by Pioneer Tobacco Company (+1 to 138), the only other riser. Fan Milk Limited (-2 to 398) was the only faller.
A total of 238,170 shares changed hands on Friday.
January 20 was the year-low turnover to date with just 2,600 shares changing hands.
